title: Ex-intelligence officer: how to tell when a CEO is lying | Gorm Thomassen
description:
Gorm Thomassen is co-founder and CIO of AKO Capital, the London-based long-term equity investor he started with Nicolai Tangen in 2005. Before finance, he trained in Norway’s military intelligence program, where he learned Russian and interrogation techniques, and then began his career as a sell-side analyst at Cazenove.

This discussion took place live on November 12th, 2026, on the MicroCapClub Community. Join MicroCapClub and unlock the ability to listen and participate live in these discussions - https://microcapclub.com/#join 

Gorm explains how AKO uses specialist accounting and behavioral teams to catch the biases its analysts can’t see in themselves, and why the firm doesn’t sell on DCF price targets. He also covers what distancing language and evasive answers reveal about management, how to run an interview that gets a CEO talking, and why he prefers larger companies even when the upside looks smaller.
